package task

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type taskDetailsRepositoryStub struct {
	repository.TaskRepository
	task *domain.Task
}

func (stub taskDetailsRepositoryStub) Get(context.Context, string) (*domain.Task, error) {
	return stub.task, nil
}

type taskLearningTargetRepositoryStub struct {
	repository.TaskLearningTargetRepository
	targets []domain.TaskLearningTarget
}

func (stub taskLearningTargetRepositoryStub) ListByTask(context.Context, string) ([]domain.TaskLearningTarget, error) {
	return stub.targets, nil
}

func TestGetTaskDetailsLoadsLearningTargets(t *testing.T) {
	taskEntity := &domain.Task{ID: "task-id"}
	targets := []domain.TaskLearningTarget{{
		TaskID: "task-id",
		Type:   domain.LearningTargetCapability,
		Key:    "learning.semantic-sequence",
	}}

	details, err := (GetTaskDetails{
		Tasks:           taskDetailsRepositoryStub{task: taskEntity},
		LearningTargets: taskLearningTargetRepositoryStub{targets: targets},
	}).Handle(context.Background(), taskEntity.ID, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(details.LearningTargets) != 1 || len(details.Task.LearningTargets) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("learning targets missing: details=%+v task=%+v", details.LearningTargets, details.Task.LearningTargets)
	}
}
